That the format lands on the named range and nowhere else, and that setting only a colour does not reset the size and face, is scripts/test-xlsx-skill.py S1-S2

X7.verified_by: L2's F3 asserts the rule count does not DECREASE, which is the fidelity half. That all three rule kinds (cellIs / colorScale / dataBar) actually arrive, on the ranges asked for, and that the rule the fixture already carried is still there, is scripts/test-xlsx-skill.py S3

X8.verified_by: L2's F3 counts chart parts from the PACKAGE rather than through openpyxl (a chart it failed to parse would read as absent on both sides and cancel out), so it catches a rebuild that dropped the fixture's existing chart.
